summary_1line: Rama, fearing Sita lost or dead, questions Lakshmana in anguish and declares life meaningless without her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands in the forest confronting Lakshmana, his face anguished as he realizes Sita is missing.
Rama, distraught in the shadowed Dandaka forest, clutches his chest while speaking of dying if Sita is gone.
